Head of Product Development and Diversification – KTDA Holdings

at KTDA Holdings Ltd
Published October 15, 2026
Expires October 22, 2026
Location Nairobi, Kenya
Category Agriculture and Agribusiness  
Job Type Full-time  

KTDA is a private company owned by about 600,000 smallholder tea farmers spread across 16 tea growing counties in Kenya. The farmers are shareholders to 54 tea companies that own KTDA (H) and its 9 subsidiary companies.

The nine subsidiary companies owned by KTDA (H) add value to the tea value chain. These companies include Chai Trading Company Limited, KTDA (Management Services), Majani Insurance Brokers, Kenya Tea Packers Limited, Greenland Fedha Limited, KTDA Foundation, Tea Machinery and Engineering Company Ltd, KTDA Power Company Limited , KTDA (MS) and Chai Logistics Centre.

KTDA Holdings Ltd

Head of Product Development and Diversification

1 Position

Research & Development

Job Location: Headquarters

Employment Type: Permanent

Position Scope: Reporting to the Group General Manager-Research, Development and Innovation, the successful candidate will be responsible for leading KTDA’s strategy for new product development, research, and diversification to reduce over-reliance on bulk orthodox and black CTC tea.

The Head of NPD will drive development of new value-added tea products, alternative beverages, and non-tea products to improve farmer earnings, expand market access, and position KTDA as a global leader in diversified agricultural products.

Duties and Responsibilities

a) Developing and implementing KTDA’s New Product Development research and Diversification strategy aligned to corporate goals and Tea Industry Act;

b) Leading the NPD Research, and Diversification teams to deliver a pipeline of commercially viable products;

c) Providing market and consumer insights to Senior Management for investment decisions;

d) Liaising with research institutions, Government Agencies and other related private institutions in executing NPD strategies;

e) Participating in review and formulation of new inputs, technologies and products in KTDA through research;

f) Reviewing and recommending for adoption of specifications for key inputs, processes and equipment;

g) Planning and coordinating New Product Development projects/strategic initiatives;

h) Identifying training tools to enhance employee performance and skill development;

i) Documenting all phases of new product development;

j) Monitoring, evaluating New Product Development projects and ensuring effective utilization of resources;

k) Identifying market trends, consumer needs, and white spaces in tea, herbal infusions, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, and other agricultural value chains;

l) Overseeing concept development, product formulation, pilot testing, sensory evaluation, and commercial launch of new KTDA products;

m) Managing end-to-end process: ideation → R&D → regulatory approval → branding → market testing → scale-up;

n) Ensuring all new products meet Tea Board, KEBS, FDA, EU, and other export market standards;

o) Leading product, market, and agronomic research in partnership with TRFK, universities, and private labs;

p) Driving research innovation in processing technologies, packaging, shelf-life extension, and sustainability in collaborations with relevant SBUs;

q) Coordinating KTDA’s product tests at the lab and manage associated budget and ensuring IP protection through patents and trademarks with KIPI;

r) Supporting factories in adoption of new processing lines for diversified products;

s) Disseminating NPD research findings to the end users;

t) Exploring and launching diversification into allied products: specialty teas, ready-to-drink, tea extracts, tea-based foods, bio-products, and carbon/tea by-products;

u) Building business cases for new ventures and JV partnerships;

v) Working with Marketing, Sales, and Factory Operations to ensure smooth handover from R&D to commercialization;

w) Tracking product P&L and ensuring ROI targets are met;

x) Preparing timely and accurate report and distributing to appropriate users

Qualifications / Skills / Experience

  • Education: Master’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Agricultural Economics, Chemistry, or Business.
  • Professional: Membership to relevant professional body e.g. KIFST, ICPAK.
  • Experience: Minimum 8-10 years’ experience, with at least 5 years in a senior NPD/R&D leadership role in FMCG, beverages, or agro-processing. Tea industry experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of launching at least 3 successful new products in the last 5 years.
  • Technical: Deep knowledge of tea chemistry, product formulation, sensory science, food safety and regulatory affairs.
  • Strategic: Market research, trend forecasting, business modeling, and portfolio management.
  • Leadership: Team management, cross-functional collaboration, project management, budget oversight.
  • Commercial: Brand positioning, pricing strategy, and go-to-market planning.
  • Data-driven decision making, innovation mindset, strong presentation and negotiation skills.
